title: CARL: Causality-guided Architecture Representation Learning for an Interpretable Performance Predictor
caption: Figure 5. Visualization results for architectures on NAS-Bench- 201 where edge types represent operations and edge direction rep- resent the computation ﬂow. ‘Skip’ denotes skip connect, ‘a3’ denotes avg-pool 3×3, ‘c3’ denotes conv 3×3, and ‘c1’ denotes conv 1×1. Node 0 is the input node and node 3 is the output node. An edge with a darker color indicates a higher importance score for this operation. (Top) well-performing architectures. (Bottom) poorly-performing architectures.
